units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2:7">Y. Sot. I, 16ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כדי לְגִימַת שלש וכ׳</he> (Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 4a:18">ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי לגמע</he>, v. <cite ref="C00996"><he>גָּמָא</he></cite>) as much time as is required for quaffing three roasted eggs.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103b:17">Snh. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>גדולה ל׳ שהרחיקה וכ׳</he> a little refreshment plays an essential part, for its refusal estranged two tribes from Israel (Ammon and Moab, v.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 23:4">Deut. XXIII, 4</cite> sq.). Ib. 52ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 35:16">Ps. XXXV, 16</cite>) <he>שהחניפו לקרח על עיסקי ל׳</he> they flattered Korah for the sake of entertainments (to which he used to invite them); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 723">Yalk. Ps. 723</cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 7a:12">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>צ̇ק̇ל̇ג̇ ומד̇מ̇נה וס̇נ̇סנה̇</he>, <cite ref="Joshua 15:31">Josh. XV, 31</cite>) <he>כל מי שיש לו צ̇עק̇ת ל̇ג̇ימא על חבירווד̇ומ̇ם שוכן בס̇נ̇ה̇ יעשה לו דין</he> if one has cause to complain of being hindered in his livelihood by his neighbor and keeps his peace, He who dwells in the thornbush will take up his cause.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 35a:18">Bekh. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>ללגימא לא חיישינן</he> we do not apprehend that their testimony may be influenced by their bread and butter, i.e. by their dependence on their employers.—Pl. <he>לְגִימוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a:12">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כנגד י׳ ל׳ וכ׳</he> corresponding to the ten meals which Nabal gave to David’s servants (<cite ref="I Samuel 25:5">I Sam. XXV, 5</cite>).
